description: The footer action a client derives from a paged list's `pageInfo`. `loadMore`: a cursor is present, the client may ask for the next page. `ceiling`: the server stopped the list (`hasMore` with no cursor) and says so with `bounded`; the client shows the ceiling words. `end`: nothing more to load. A null cursor never loads more, whatever `hasMore` says. `bounded` is optional and false when missing. Consumer: tests/loadMoreModel.test.ts (pageFooterAction).
